title: Ship Stålheart's LOD1 and LOD2 as its landmark tiers
context: Stålheart's runtime LODs are pinned at c827eda and verified in the story lab and the real game camera (2026-09-14-stalheart-lods-in-game-camera-review). The author and the owner both mark them pending game-camera and reference-phone review.
outcome: Proposed, not done. Point the Stålheart structure's asset at LOD1 and its far tier at LOD2, drop the derived far tier and its entry in docs/far-tier-assets.lock.json (npm run tiers stops deriving it once far no longer points under assets/models/far/), delete the orphaned derived file so the release does not keep shipping it, and settle the swap threshold. Expected gain: a game tier of 57.7 KB instead of 555.5 KB packed, 7,342 triangles in 10 draws instead of 40,506 in 105, and a one-draw distance tier. Blocked on the owner's review of swap distance, projected size and frame rate on the reference phone at index.html?world=story&stage=6&landmarks=candidate#td.
alternatives: Ship LOD1 only and keep the derived far tier.
Wait for the upstream assembly-line and SH02 LODs and ship every landmark tier together.
